description: Figure 7 presents the distribution of different task types across turns from verified Wildchat journalist-LLM conversations for Agency A. The pie chart contains three slices representing “Article generation”, “Article editing”, and “Headline generation”. The “Article generation” slice is colored blue and occupies approximately 82.3% of the chart. The “Article editing” slice is colored orange and represents roughly 14.4% of the chart. Finally, the “Headline generation” slice is colored green and accounts for approximately 3.3% of the chart. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. A legend is present, associating colors with task types. The slices are not visually emphasized or ordered in any particular way.
